title: Wordkeep: Markdown Notes
shortDescription: Markdown notes and to-do lists, kept as plain files on your phone.
fullDescription:
Wordkeep is a calm place to write. Every note is a plain Markdown file on your phone, so your words open in any text editor, today and in twenty years.

WRITE IN MARKDOWN
Type # for a heading, ** for bold and - [ ] for a task. Syntax highlighting keeps the raw text readable, and the preview shows the finished page in one tap.

KEEP IT ORGANIZED
Pin what matters, star your favorites and give every note a soft color. Add labels, archive what you are done with, and keep real folders for your journal, recipes or work.

LISTS THAT CHECK OFF
Task lists live inside any note. Keep a todo.txt, a reading list or a packing list, and tick items off as you go.

FIND YOUR PLACE
Search finds any word and highlights it in the matching lines. The document outline jumps to any heading in a long note. Undo and redo, find and replace, and a focus mode are all there when you need them.

MAKE IT YOURS
Light or dark, with twelve color themes, including your wallpaper's colors. Adjust the font size, line numbers and word wrap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-in. Notes stay in the app's private storage, or in a shared Documents folder you can sync with any tool you like.

On tablets, notes open right over your notebook, so you never lose your place.

Wordkeep is a modern port of Markor, the open-source Markdown editor by Gregor Santner.
